title: Rooms and narrow spaces take their skylight from the world round them
summary: Rooms under a roof, wall feet and gaps between houses lose skylight; open ground is unchanged.
stage: --scenario=breach --seed=3 --fixed-fps 30. Midday room: --mood=day --focus=0,-30 --zoom=8 --pitch=-62 at 5 s. Golden-hour room: --mood=golden --focus=0,-30 --zoom=12 --pitch=-40 --cam-yaw=0.5 at 5 s. Between houses (review): --mood=golden --focus=7,-31 --zoom=12 --pitch=-10 at 12 s. Destruction: --mood=day --focus=12,-31 --zoom=14 --pitch=-50 --blast-at=14,-29,3,6, 60 frames every 0.1 s. The roof over the room is lifted by the defenders inside.
rationale: Each sheet is cropped tight on where probes matter. OFF is a --set=light_probes:0 run; ON, the probe term and the bent normal are consecutive frames of a --set=light_probes:2 run cycling them (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle). The scenario is deterministic at a fixed frame rate, so OFF and ON are the same moment (only smoke differs). The flicker clip alternates them on one frame; the destruction clip pairs the game with the probe term from a second identical run (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_VIEW=1).

capture.provenance: Recaptured off-screen from this branch (Forward+, RTX 3090, High preset) with the commands in stage; panels are consecutive frames of one fixed-fps run, so they share camera, units and smoke.
capture.comparison: Player sheets: top left probes off, bottom left on, top right the probe term (sky share on grey, bounce amplified), bottom right ON minus OFF x4 on mid grey. Review sheets (PR only) show the bent normal instead of the difference. Flicker: off and on alternate each second on one frame. Destruction: the game and the probe term from two identical fixed-fps runs.
capture.limits: Measured: the midday room falls to 0.73 of its brightness (sunlit floor 0.60, shaded floor 0.69); in it the shade is 0.22 of the sunlit floor in linear light. Outdoors the change is small (golden hour between houses: 2.4 levels mean); roof tops and open ground stay at 1.00. Smoke differs between OFF and ON runs. Trenches are narrower than the 2 m grid and are not shown. The destruction clip predates the floor-bounce change. The Compatibility renderer (browser) gets the skylight shading and bounce but not the indoor sun cut.

source_ref: dines/probe-grid-gi-0571ca: the warm-bounce commit after edadf5ca.
